speaker: abel_garnish
text: The property hand has gone missing again. It must be a bladder till Saturday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is a bladder till Saturday. I am not naming the man who lost it, and I am not naming the Roman I play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A bladder will serve the afternoon. Ten shillings apiece is after the play, not at this rehearsal. Do not open the book now.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will not open the book. I will tie the bladder, and I will curse the corner where the hand was.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Curse the corner. I am dead by the fourth act. That is all the plot needs from me this morning.
